field_map.date: trading date, floored at 2022-05-16 (VIX1D's first full trading day) so every record has all six tenors populated — no null-padding
field_map.vvix: Cboe VVIX — volatility of VIX itself (close)
field_map.vix_vix3m_ratio: vix/vix3m — <1 normal contango, >=1 backwardation (stress); derived, not published by Cboe
field_map.vix9d_vix_ratio: vix9d/vix — front-end stress relative to the 30-day level; derived, not published by Cboe

confidence_model: RAW official index levels + two straightforward derived ratios, shown as reference data only.
